title: Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire

note.windows: The first build takes 20 to 60 minutes and about 2 GB. Python, CMake, Ninja and the Visual Studio Build Tools (about 3 GB) are installed if they are missing; Windows asks for permission once.
note.default: Shadows of the Empire builds on Windows only: it runs on Steam's own DirectDraw-to-Direct3D 9 wrapper. Use the Windows installer.
